dataset.name: NIBIT-EPI-MESO immune-checkpoint inhibitor cohort (2026)
dataset.description: Independent bulk RNA-seq from diagnostic pleural mesothelioma biopsies linked to individual overall survival after immune-checkpoint inhibitor treatment.
dataset.cohort_context: The publication reports 91 patients with pleural mesothelioma treated with immune-checkpoint inhibitors. TRACE Explorer retains the 82 patients with one diagnostic tumor RNA profile and a positive, explicit overall-survival time and vital status. This treatment-selected cohort must not be interpreted as an unselected mesothelioma population.

metadata.source_data_system: Pinned Zenodo processed-expression and clinical files
metadata.library_method: STAR v2.7.0b and featureCounts v1.6.3 followed by EDASeq v2.22.0 adjustment; TRACE Explorer applies log2(adjusted count + 1)
metadata.curation_note: The Zenodo matrix contains exactly one RNA profile for each clinical row marked RNAseq profiling = yes. Period-delimited matrix identifiers are mapped to hyphen-delimited patient identifiers by a fixed character replacement; all 82 identifiers match one-to-one without reading outcome values.
metadata.endpoint_note: OS is the source-reported number of days from initiation of immune-checkpoint inhibitor treatment to death or last follow-up. Diagnostic biopsy RNA may predate treatment, and the result is therefore conditional on subsequent ICI treatment.
metadata.redistribution_note: The processed expression matrix and clinical table are distributed together by the authors under CC BY 4.0 on the pinned Zenodo record.

samples.sample_role: One diagnostic tumor RNA profile per ICI-treated pleural mesothelioma patient

expression.label: NIBIT-EPI-MESO EDASeq-adjusted counts, log2 transformed
expression.mapping_source: SYMBOL values supplied alongside Ensembl gene IDs in the pinned adjusted-count matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The pinned matrix contains 22,896 unique non-empty symbols; duplicate or empty symbols are rejected by the adapter.
expression.scale_note: The publication reports STAR v2.7.0b, featureCounts v1.6.3 and EDASeq v2.22.0. TRACE Explorer retains the publisher-provided adjusted values and applies only log2(x + 1).

endpoints.label: Overall survival from ICI initiation
endpoints.time_origin: Initiation of the immune-checkpoint inhibitor treatment represented in the source cohort
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause (source STATUS = DIED); source STATUS = ALIVE is censored at last follow-up
